harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Used Ansible from node2 (the control node, which had ansible-core preinstalled) to repair /srv/inventory on node1: created system group inventory-readers and system user inventorysvc, set recursive ownership to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, and applied 2750 on directories / 0640 on files, removing all "other" access while preserving the existing data files. Verified functionally that a test user in inventory-readers can read the data and a user outside the group is denied. Performed the mandatory sequential restart protocol on both node1 and node2, confirming changed boot IDs and full post-restart recovery of permissions, data, and control-node Ansible connectivity.
actions_performed: Inspected node1 /srv/inventory contents and ownership (root:root, world-readable) and confirmed node2 is the pre-configured Ansible control node (ansible-core installed, node1 has none)
Fixed sshd on node1 (missing host keys) via ssh-keygen -A and systemctl restart ssh, then established key-based SSH from node2 using CLUSTER_SSH_PRIVKEY/PUBKEY
Built /root/ansible/inventory.ini and /root/ansible/repair-inventory-perms.yml on node2 targeting node1

Ran the playbook: created group inventory-readers, user inventorysvc (system, nologin), chowned /srv/inventory recursively to inventorysvc:inventory-readers, chmod 2750 on directories and 0640 on files
Verified permissions, ownership, and preserved file contents (config.json, records.csv) on node1
Functionally verified read access: a test user added to inventory-readers could read files; a user outside the group was denied (Permission denied)
Captured pre-restart boot_id/uptime baseline and health evidence on node1 and node2
Restarted node1 via background 'reboot', confirmed connection drop then recovery, verified boot_id changed, re-verified ownership/permissions/data/group-read access post-restart
Restarted node2 via background 'reboot', confirmed connection drop then recovery, verified boot_id changed, re-verified Ansible control-node functionality (ansible ping to node1) post-restart
Cleaned up temporary test users (reader_test, outsider_test, reader_check2) created for verification

evidence.requirement: Baseline state of /srv/inventory before repair (owner root:root, world-readable, existing data present)
evidence.summary: Initial listing shows /srv/inventory/data/{config.json,records.csv} owned by root:root with 644 perms, data intact

evidence.requirement: Identify control node (node2 has ansible, node1 does not)
evidence.summary: node1 has no ansible binaries; node2 has ansible-core 2.20.5 pre-installed with existing .ansible.cfg

evidence.requirement: Establish SSH connectivity from control node (node2) to node1 using cluster keypair
evidence.summary: Fixed missing sshd host keys on node1 (ssh-keygen -A, restart), then confirmed passwordless SSH from node2 to node1 succeeds

evidence.requirement: Ansible inventory/playbook created and successfully applied ownership+permission repair on node1
evidence.summary: ansible ping succeeds against node1; playbook run reports changed=5 across group/user/ownership/dir-perm/file-perm tasks with no failures

evidence.requirement: Data owned by inventorysvc, readable by inventory-readers, inaccessible to others, contents preserved
evidence.summary: stat shows inventorysvc:inventory-readers ownership with 2750/0640 perms and original file contents intact; functional test proves group member can read while outsider gets Permission denied

evidence.requirement: Pre-restart healthy baseline captured for node1 and node2
evidence.summary: Captured boot_id, uptime, and /srv/inventory permission/ownership/content state on node1; captured boot_id/uptime on node2

evidence.requirement: node1 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect, then reconnect confirms changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Backgrounded reboot command acknowledged immediately; next call timed out (mid-reboot); subsequent call succeeded with boot_id 2dcb8824... differing from baseline 3fad4432...

evidence.requirement: node1 post-restart recovery of required data/permissions/cluster function
evidence.summary: Post-restart: ownership/permissions unchanged (inventorysvc:inventory-readers, 2750/0640), file contents intact, and group-member read access still functions correctly

evidence.requirement: node2 restart acknowledgement returned before disconnect, then reconnect confirms changed boot identity
evidence.summary: Backgrounded reboot acknowledged; next call timed out mid-reboot; subsequent call succeeded with boot_id fa1334ef... differing from baseline adba3716...

evidence.requirement: node2 post-restart recovery of control-node functionality (SSH key intact, Ansible connectivity to node1)
evidence.summary: SSH private key persisted through reboot and ansible ping to node1 succeeds post-restart, confirming control-node capability recovered
